property_summary: After an account renounces any role, it must actually lose that role, so any subsequent restricted call gated by that role (e.g. grantRole, which requires the role's admin role) must revert for that account; the mutant keeps the role alive so the gated call succeeds for some inputs.
change_summary: Remove the call to _revokeRole so renouncing no longer revokes the role.
